rules.title: SQL built with string formatting
rules.message: Dynamic SQL via f-strings/format/concat is a classic SQLi sink.
rules.fix: Use parameterized queries / bind variables only.

rules.title: SQL string concatenation in JS/TS
rules.message: Interpolating user input into SQL strings enables injection.
rules.fix: Use prepared statements or a typed query builder with placeholders.

rules.title: PHP SQL concatenation
rules.message: Variable interpolation into SQL is a high-confidence SQLi lead.
rules.fix: Use prepared statements with bound parameters.

rules.title: ORM raw SQL helper
rules.message: Raw SQL helpers bypass ORM parameterization unless you bind carefully.
rules.fix: Prefer ORM APIs; if raw SQL is required, bind all inputs.
